svg.text: 1 M3 x 8 socket head cap screw, head flush with the grille face
2 Grille port Ø6.15 (Ø6.0 + 0.075 per side), 0.5 x 45° chamfer
3 Baffle counterbore Ø6.0 x 1.5, membrane 0.25: drill Ø3.4
4 Insert M3 x 3 (short), in the sleeve front post
5 Pilot Ø1.6 with 45° tip: drill Ø4.0 x 7
6 Sleeve lead-in chamfer 0.6 x 45°; panel fit gap 0.3
7 Strip pocket Ø6.5 x 1.0 covers the tray screw head
(head 0.75 in front of the baffle, 0.25 clear)
8 Tray tab: pilot Ø1.6, drill Ø4.0 through, insert M3 x 3
Joint details: front corner and tray screws
